svg.title: One purchase through near-preflight
svg.desc: Read left to right. Outside near-preflight, dashed: the AI agent (untrusted, holds no key for Base), NEAR Chain Signatures (NEAR's signing network) and the Base blockchain (a local fork in the demo). Inside the green near-preflight frame: the guard contract on NEAR, three sentinels and the proof anyone can replay. 1: the agent asks the guard to check a token and an amount. 2: each sentinel reads the request and simulates the buy and the resale on Base. 3: each posts its vote to the guard; an allow takes two matching votes of three. 4: the guard has Chain Signatures sign the swap. Then anyone can broadcast the signed swap to Base, no key needed.
